name: Save Restricted Test Bot
description: Private test bot using the external EasyProto Telegram library.

TG_API_HASH.description: Your Telegram API hash. Keep private.

TG_BOT_TOKEN.description: Token for your own bot from BotFather. Keep private.

OWNER_IDS.description: Comma-separated numeric user IDs allowed to use the bot.

SOURCE_CHAT_IDS.description: Comma-separated signed IDs of source chats you own or may access.

TG_USER_SESSION_B64.description: Optional private native EasyProto session for restart restoration. Leave empty to log in through the bot's /login command.

TG_BOT_SESSION_B64.description: Optional private EasyProto bot session export. If absent, the bot token authorizes a new session after a dyno replacement.

SESSION_DIR.description: Private runtime session files, restored from Config Vars at startup.

LOGIN_OWNER_ID.description: Optional owner user ID allowed to authorize the shared source account. Defaults to the smallest OWNER_IDS entry.

LOGIN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Total login time limit, 30 to 900 seconds.

TRANSFER_WORKERS.description: Chunk workers: 1, 2 or 4. Start with 1 for testing.

MAX_CONCURRENT_TRANSFERS.description: Keep one simultaneous transfer during initial testing.

MAX_FILE_BYTES.description: Files must remain strictly below 2 GB (decimal).
